snippet.title: Shapes N Music Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play now on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903050/Shapes_N_Music/

Shapes N Music is a brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a great soundtrack synced to intense levels. Enjoy additional game modes built to ruin your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

Music: ISMTUD, Artifex - Spiritual Scenery ~ A Thousand Colors
